import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

src_csv = Path('/utils/april-attendance-data.csv')
out_xlsx = Path('/workspace/audit-export.xlsx')

assert src_csv.exists(), f"Source CSV not found: {src_csv}"

# Load CSV
# Strip whitespace in column names and values
_df = pd.read_csv(src_csv)
_df.columns = [c.strip() for c in _df.columns]
for c in ['Name', 'Date', 'Clock-in', 'Clock-out']:
    _df[c] = _df[c].astype(str).str.strip()

# Parse datetimes
# Combine Date + times to proper datetimes
in_dt = pd.to_datetime(_df['Date'] + ' ' + _df['Clock-in'], format='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')
out_dt = pd.to_datetime(_df['Date'] + ' ' + _df['Clock-out'], format='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')

# Determine who clocked in after 09:15
threshold_time = datetime.strptime('09:15', '%H:%M').time()
late_mask = in_dt.dt.time > threshold_time

# Adjust clock-out by -3 hours where late
adjusted_out_dt = out_dt.where(~late_mask, out_dt - pd.to_timedelta(3, unit='h'))

# Recompute work hours
work_duration = (adjusted_out_dt - in_dt)
# Prevent negative durations just in case (clip at zero)
work_duration = work_duration.where(work_duration >= pd.Timedelta(0), pd.Timedelta(0))

# Build adjusted display columns
adj_df = _df.copy()
adj_df['Adjusted Clock-out'] = adjusted_out_dt.dt.strftime('%H:%M')
# Compute hours as decimal and hh:mm
adj_df['Worked (hours)'] = (work_duration.dt.total_seconds() / 3600).round(2)
# Also add a human-readable HH:MM
adj_df['Worked (HH:MM)'] = (work_duration.dt.components['hours']).astype(int).astype(str).str.zfill(2) + ':' + \
                           (work_duration.dt.components['minutes']).astype(int).astype(str).str.zfill(2)

# Compute average hours per employee (using adjusted times)
avg_df = (
    adj_df.groupby('Name', as_index=False)['Worked (hours)']
          .mean()
          .rename(columns={'Worked (hours)':'Average Worked (hours)'})
)
